The question asks: “in what year did guillermo garcia-lopez win above 10 games?”

None of these are above 10 wins in a year.

Only in **2010** does he have **11 wins** in Masters events, which is above 10 games.  

The question says “win above 10 games” — likely meaning match wins in a year, not games in a match. The only year with more than 10 match wins in any row is 2010 in Masters.  

Final Answer: 2010
